issue.title: Message board: autonomous agent completion watch on athena (00b)
issue.description:
Purpose and explicit authorization
This memory task is an operational message board for Bryan's newly requested sequence of agents monitoring all SASE work on athena. It is a proof of concept for whether a dedicated message-board bead type is useful. No memory file edit or new bead-type implementation is requested. Use append-only attributed notes for the baton; keep this record open rather than ready so it does not generate unrelated Memory TaskTriage work.

This is a new supervision epoch rooted at agent 00b, under Bryan's renewed instruction to create a NEW bead and launch autonomously. Earlier board bead:sase-xs covers the preceding 00a epoch, whose last checkpoint ended in LaunchApproval rather than an hourly monitor. Retain and reconcile that evidence; this board is the current baton. The new-board instruction intentionally overrides normal semantic-duplicate corroboration for this operational log, not for any discovered defect tasks. Do not discard, close, or overwrite the earlier board. If an earlier supervisor later appears, reconcile ownership through board notes before acting on the same failed run.

Mission and model
Ensure every assigned task in scope reaches substantive completion, including verification and required commits/finalizers. Cover all projects on this machine; include current running, waiting and queued agents, new agents appearing while supervision runs, continuations and retries, and unresolved failed assignments. Model for every agent newly launched by this chain is codex/gpt-6-astra, with supervisor reasoning effort xhigh. Omit --model on monitors to inherit it. For retries/restarts explicitly route codex/gpt-6-astra@xhigh while preserving the task. Healthy existing agents retain their settings.

Bryan explicitly authorizes the necessary investigation, appropriate repairs, commits via /sase_git_commit, and retry/restart launches. Agents MUST NOT use /sase_run or ask Bryan for permission before launching these agents. Use the installed sase run and sase agent restart interfaces directly within that authorization. Older board text recommending /sase_run or LaunchApproval is superseded by this instruction. Do not invent an approval for unrelated human decisions or bypass an actual security control; if the installed command itself refuses, record the precise refusal, pursue supported recovery, and keep supervision alive rather than declaring success.

Ordered check-in procedure
1. Read this description, the latest checkpoint, and unresolved ledger notes. Capture machine-wide sase agent list -a -j and sase monitor list --json. Review all running and waiting work, progress timestamps/file sizes, process and child-command liveness, workflow checkpoints, dependency beads, queue thresholds and slot holders. Check pending gates/continuations as appropriate. A long duration or unchanged planning shell alone is not a stall. Plan/code rows can share a PID; reconcile family state and authoritative done.json before restarting anything. Preserve per-run keys (project, name, started_at, artifacts_dir) and compare fingerprints with the prior checkpoint. Investigate confirmed stalls, fix their underlying cause when appropriate, verify and commit fixes using /sase_git_commit, then restart unfinished/uncommitted work. Preview sase agent restart NAME --dry-run because it can delete old and related artifacts; preserve uncommitted work and recovery evidence, then use --yes and the required model. Recheck actual launch and ensure fixes reached the runtime/revision used by the retry.
2. Investigate every new or still-unresolved failed assignment. Search for already-live or successful replacements before launching another. For an ordinary failed retry, recover the IDENTICAL stored raw_xprompt.md task, changing only identity/model and necessary identity metadata. Use allocate_retry_name from sase.agent.names, rewrite_retry_prompt_name from sase.agent.relaunch_prompt (handles clan/family identity), and set_prompt_model from sase.xprompt.directive_edit. Verify the resulting explicit %id places the new run in the failed agent's hood, such as failed-name.r0; preserve project/VCS routing, bead linkage, dependencies, workflows and finalizers. Launch using sase run with a safely quoted argument or Python subprocess argument array. Never replace the raw task with an expanded summary, silently route GitHub work to home, or force same-name reuse for ordinary failed retries. Record intent BEFORE launching, outcome AFTER, and track the replacement until its task and finalizer succeed. A live retry is pending recovery, not resolved failure. Reconcile exact-name waiters because a child-hood retry may not satisfy them automatically. Commit prerequisite fixes first. Avoid duplicate active retries and repeated blind retry loops; persistent transient failures are revisited at the next hourly check.
3. Reconcile the durable ledger and take a fresh inventory. The recent list caps completed entries at 50 per project: use uncapped sase agent search 'status:FAILED' -j -l 0 plus exact lookups and saved evidence so hourly gaps or disappearance cannot hide failures. Do not call every historical failure an unfinished task; match it to later verified completion. DONE alone is insufficient where task/finalizer evidence contradicts it. Resolve waiting prerequisites rather than fabricating bead closures. The termination condition is zero running/waiting/queued target agents, zero active dependent monitors/gates or pending continuations, and zero failed assignments without verified successful recovery. Exclude only this supervision family 00b and its own sleep monitors from target counts; an old supervisor still doing real work is not automatically excluded. Confirm with a second fresh inventory after reconciliation. Any unresolved evidence or real blocker means continue.
4. If termination is proven, append a concise final analysis here and give the same analysis in the normal final response: interventions, commits/tests, retry outcomes, timestamped zero-target evidence, and why all tracked work is complete. Include observations about this message-board experiment. Use /sase_final as the last action before the response. Leave this memory-shaped operational log open; the final note is sufficient. Do not schedule another monitor once complete.

Cadence and mechanical continuation
Setup schedules sleep 60 exactly once for this new epoch. The waking successor performs the ordered check-in immediately. After every incomplete check-in, append the checkpoint, then use /sase_monitor to schedule sleep 3600 and a successor with this SAME model. The installed syntax is:
sase monitor start -s SLEEPING -S SLEPT -t 70m -L 'Agent supervision' -r 'Hourly completion check; read this message board' --next '<self-contained recurring instructions including this bead ID>' --next-output none -- sleep 3600
The setup monitor uses -t 5m and sleep 60. There is no --command option in the currently installed CLI. No idle timeout for deliberate quiet sleep. A successful monitor start ends the current provider turn mechanically; do not poll it or promise an unmechanized continuation. A nonzero start is NOT a handoff; diagnose/retry it. Preserve the four-step recurrence, authorization, model and board ID in every --next. If remediation needs its own long verification monitor, carry the supervision obligation through that successor and then resume the hourly cadence.

Checkpoint format and completion ledger
At check-in start: UTC timestamp, supervisor, predecessor and cycle number. Before handing off: compact running/waiting/queued list and blockers; unresolved failed-run -> retry mapping with precise run keys; progress evidence; interventions and commit/test receipts; newly verified completions; remaining actions; termination decision; next sleep duration. Save bulky inventories as indexed artifacts (sase artifact create) and link canonical refs rather than embedding megabytes in notes. Use sase artifact read for later audited evidence reads. Retain enough progress/identity evidence in the note to recover if a transient scratch file disappears. Append notes using sase bead note; do not edit or remove predecessors' notes.

Repository boundaries remain in force: /sase_repo before reading or editing any other checkout; shared backend behavior belongs in sase-core. Follow applicable instructions and verification memory before finishing any code change. /sase_git_commit is explicitly authorized here when an actual repair requires a commit; no empty commit is needed for observation or the board itself. Discoveries outside this mission follow /sase_new_task duplicate/epic routing.

Metadata
Owner: Bryan. Host: athena. Current supervisor root: 00b. Requested model: codex/gpt-6-astra@xhigh. Size: large because remediation scope is unknown and may span projects; it is planning metadata, not a request to launch a separate task worker. Message-board experiment: mandatory memory fields are sentinel values, and the ordinary ready/triage lifecycle does not fit an ongoing operational log. Evaluate usefulness without creating another feature task merely to propose a new bead type.
